evidence_scope: Static repository reading only at MAIN bcbaf324187137010b19814d6ef6e59db4d1f5d9. Exact quotes are limited to text present in repository rule/model/page files; no uncited HTA source lines were invented.

official_forms.official_mechanism: No Add/Delete row builder. Choosing the zero/blank ATC in a fixed row disables and zeros amount/rate in place; no row compaction is evidenced.
official_forms.compact_or_clear_in_place: clear/zero in place only; no removal control and no compaction

quotes.quote: Applying that predicate to the pinned DOM produces 98 static occurrences; `getRdo()` injects the RDO select into `frmMain`, producing 99 occurrences total. There are 98 distinct serialized keys because the DOM contains two `txtEmail` controls and the loop emits both under the same key. Six ATC rows are concrete and bounded. No Add/Delete row builder or unbounded family exists.

"rule_id": "2551q-atc-row-enable" ... "condition": "An ATC row selection is zero or nonzero." ... "source_refs": ["official-hta-runtime#drpATCChanged:L2976-L2997"] ... "official_behavior": "Zero selection disables and zeros amount/rate; a selected ATC enables amount and copies the catalog rate."

official_forms.caveat: The repository evidence proves no Add/Delete builder and fixed rows; it does not contain any Delete handler because none is documented.

official_forms.official_delete_or_remove_control: no per-row Delete/Remove control found. The official UI uses the ATC checkbox popup; runtime inventory also records a popup-level Clear button (`btnClearOtherAtc`) but not a row delete button.
official_forms.official_mechanism: Rows are positional projections of ticked ATC checkboxes. Rows 1-6 always exist after populateAtcPart2; rows 7-N exist only when more than six ATCs are selected. Thus unticking reduces/rebuilds the selected-row projection in popup order rather than leaving an independent row object. The exact HTA statements for unticking are not quoted in the repository artifacts, so this compaction conclusion is an evidence-backed inference from the documented positional row existence and getATCCode refs, not a literal source quote.
official_forms.compact_or_clear_in_place: checkbox selection model; rows are rebuilt/compact positional slots. No evidence of a table-row clear-in-place Delete control.

quotes.quote: The representative dummy save contains the initial six ATC rows. Source inspection proves up to 111 dynamic row positions. Because each added row contributes four serialized keys, the complete category-dependent source-reachable union is 621 fields. ... ATC row slots are positional within the selected Private/Government catalog, not permanent meanings.
quotes.quote_note: Ellipsis joins two non-contiguous repository sentences: line 15 and line 19.

"condition": "Only additional ATC rows numbered 7 and above." ... "official_formula": "AdditionalATCTotal = sum(TaxWithheld[row], row=7..(compute-table rows + other-table rows - 4))." ... "trigger": "Additional ATC row computation, selection change, clear, or year/rate refresh."

official_forms.port_crosscheck: crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1601eq.rs:5-14 says the port is of changedrpATCList/getATCCode/populateAtcPart2 and dynamically adds popup checkboxes/rows; remove_atc at lines 874-877 retains nonmatching rows and recompute sorts rows in popup order at lines 891-895.
official_forms.caveat: The rules package does not quote the literal HTA lines showing what btnClearOtherAtc or an individual untick executes; no stronger claim is made.

official_forms.official_delete_or_remove_control: Add/Delete behavior exists for the dynamic rows, including Schedule 1; no maximum-row guard.
official_forms.official_mechanism: Repository evidence proves Add/Delete and unbounded indexed families, but does not quote enough of the dynamic-row-builder implementation to establish whether official Delete compacts rows up or clears in place. Serialization metadata uses assigned stable row ids and marks serialization order unresolved, so it does not settle compaction either.
official_forms.compact_or_clear_in_place: unestablished from the repository official-form artifacts; do not infer. Host runtime behavior compacts backing arrays, but that is host behavior, not proof of the official HTA mechanism.

quotes.quote: The concrete union therefore has 160 keys. Source inspection also proves 28 unbounded indexed families: nine Schedule 1 fields, five Schedule 3 fields, six Schedule 4 fields, and description/amount pairs for Items 19, 42, 47, and 56. The HTA has Add/Delete behavior and no maximum-row guard, so `fields.json` records family descriptors instead of inventing a finite row count.

"source_refs": ["official-hta-runtime#dynamic-row-builders:L5830-L6760", "official-hta-runtime#serialization:L5160-L5820"] ... "The HTA exposes Add/Delete without a maximum-row guard; this descriptor prevents a false finite inventory claim."
